authority: Existing direct user authorization for clean local VM/runtime preparation, renewed by okay proceed; no checkpoint conversion or research authorization inferred
scope: One targeted diskless firmware start and stop of the already repaired dedicated VM, to observe Hyper-V logical running-state storage before any OS image acquisition. Not an isolated conversion test or proof of a usable guest/runtime.
performed_by: User's administrator PowerShell session. Agent remains unelevated and does not bypass the integrity boundary.

requirements.configuration_snapshot_and_smart_paging_: Exact dedicated root or descendants, with no redirected ancestors or members

time_and_output.output_limit_mechanism: Pre-reservation plus sampled file-size guard and immediate stop. NOT a hard filesystem quota; unexpected overhead can exceed a sample guard and must be reported and retained.
time_and_output.stop_mechanism: Primary Stop-VM -TurnOff plus separate inherited-administrator hidden stop-only PowerShell helper. No UAC or execution-policy bypass. Source hash and helper PID readiness verified before VM start.
time_and_output.limitations: Only preparation firmware, with no disk or scientific object. Hyper-V/service failures or late/ambiguous start completion require exact-state reconciliation, not a retry. The helper is not proof of hardened future research wall-time enforcement.

failure_rule: Preserve all existing and new receipts and VM files. Stop this exact VM where possible; no VM deletion, recreation, automatic retry or evidence cleanup.

storage_accounting.future_topology: The local preparation VM is provisionally charged to the same canonical 4 GB runtime reservation, not an additional runtime plus cluster image. The 1 GB nonruntime local/preparation line is unchanged. Full guest/runtime acquisition, transport and archive topology still must be reconciled before further expansion. No cluster or SSD copies added now.

preparation_time_accounting.basis: Full finite reservation retained as a charge for read-only tool/resource/source checks, script preparation and artificial/static/default interface checks, and one subsequent user-performed firmware probe plus helper. Not measured 600-second work. Any overrun must be separately charged before continuation.
